authority: Non-authoritative P2 display vocabulary; descriptive only

rules.implementation: closed axis set; homes and kinds from semantic_ref only; X only through declared facets; M/O reserved
seven declared pairs in either orientation, each with a written membership rule
declared fields only, no transitive closure; repetitions allowed and listed
P0 §3.2 reading order for kinds and dimensions; layer map or source order for referents; declared step order; catalog order for methods
equal cells, one fill, blank cells undrawn; entries whole or moved to +n more; legend states the membership rule
rows then columns in declared order; (row, column, entry) coverage; check-panels re-renders every input; detail never splits
VP-07 source 0.7.1/0.7.2 or axes input; from-plan reuses the unchanged VP-07 adapter and transcribes P1.11 bindings
no distance, scale, rank, score or numeric vector; steps are not a time scale; neutral display only
